text:
It is done, and submitted. You can play “Survival” by signing up at http://gamej.mn/games/s/9X2C7XD8T/1443126341

Thanks. I cut the game back a bit. Added some options, and simplified the controls. Added the options so that you can switch between the different “Play Mode” modes after the main game has kicked off. The original game will be in the “Options” menu.

You can edit the CSS file to customize it further.

When a single player completes the game it pauses, but a twin player game does not. I have made some slight fixes. It should play more smoothly now, and load more quickly on smaller browsers.

Take-Off

I forgot to mention that a “Take-Off” feature was added. This was a challenge to coding, and of course the sound.

You may be able to start the game without the challenge, but after some time it will become obvious that you need to show up for “man” duty and complete the game at its conclusion.

Right now the only option pod is the P-51D with the three variants that it had in WWII. But I added a P-51D_F_S to the arsenal that I will use in later stages as a dogfighter in the war.

A new feature has been added, namely, an “Ice Drill Attack” maneuver. This gives the twin players a chance to practice this thrilling maneuver that my dad taught me as a boy in the 50’s.

I may not have many dozen people play the game a week, but it may add to my “Game Credits”. It is kind of fun to be a “Game Developer” if only for a momentary thrill.
